claim: Try a sample health export without saving it to real cleaner preferences.
sandbox: fresh browser context opens /demo; assert the sample is ready, the banner is present, and the only preference database uses the demo: namespace

claim: Opens CSV and Apple Health XML health exports.
sandbox: fresh /demo context opens the shipped CSV sample and a minimal Apple Health Record XML file

claim: Inspect and export a health file without an account or installation.
sandbox: fresh browser context opens /demo with no account state or installed app, then downloads the sample clean package

claim: The utility is free to use and links to its MIT-licensed source code.
sandbox: fresh /demo context verifies the free/source statement, repository link, absence of checkout UI, and repository MIT license

claim: No third-party runtime scripts, fonts, analytics, or trackers are included.
sandbox: fresh /demo context records the whole load and clean/download flow; assert every request and runtime script or stylesheet is same-origin and no API request occurs

claim: Health records stay on this device and are not uploaded or retained.
where: landing facts, cleaner, privacy notice, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context uploads unique health values while every request is recorded; reload and inspect browser storage

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh context visits /demo, waits for the service worker, switches offline, reloads, and inspects the sample

claim: Blocks common direct identifiers and location fields before export.
sandbox: fresh /demo context uploads a CSV containing direct identifiers and location; inspect the downloaded ZIP CSV

claim: Filters by date and record type, removes chosen fields, and reduces timestamps to day or hour.
sandbox: fresh /demo context sets a date boundary, removes a record type and field, selects hour precision, and inspects the downloaded CSV

claim: CSV detects recorded_at, excludes rows without usable dates under a boundary, and groups files without a type column as CSV record.
where: landing date help and README supported sources
sandbox: fresh /demo context uploads bounded and no-type CSV fixtures; assert omitted rows, recorded_at bounds, grouping warning, and disabled empty export

claim: Apple Health XML imports Record entries only and omits workouts, routes, clinical records, ActivitySummary, and nested metadata.
where: landing limits and README supported sources
sandbox: fresh /demo context uploads XML with one Record and uniquely marked unsupported sections; inspect source count, warning, and ZIP output

claim: Downloads a cleaned CSV and provenance note in one ZIP.
sandbox: fresh /demo context downloads the sample output and inspects both archive entries

claim: Files are limited to 100 MB and 500,000 records for safety.
sandbox: fresh /demo context sends a 100 MB plus one byte File and a 500,001-row CSV through the intake; both are rejected before a cleaned copy can be made

claim: Preview the result and the exact number of removed rows and fields.
sandbox: fresh /demo context narrows the sample date range and asserts the kept, omitted, and removed-field counts shown in the receipt

claim: The parser uses structural limits and rejects malformed quoted CSV input or unrelated XML.
sandbox: fresh /demo context uploads malformed CSV then unrelated XML and asserts the specific errors and sample recovery

claim: Exports and imports only the timestamp-precision preference, never health records.
where: landing preference tools and README demo/privacy sections
sandbox: fresh /demo context exports hour precision and verifies the exact JSON, then imports day precision and observes the selected control
